wholePhysicalScope: Exact named native monument point and measured bronze plaque; reconstructed pedestal envelope.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the molded pedestal, archival plaque, four legs, long-haired standing cast and plumed tail.
limitations: The exact named monument point fixes the position. The pedestal dimensions beyond the measured sign and its garden-facing orientation are estimates.
The figure is an original model of a life-size long-coated dog based on the stated standing pose, drooping ears, neck ruff and bushy tail. Fine likeness and proportions are approximate.
The 112 by 66 cm plaque is modeled at the documented size. The sixteen lines use abstract relief strokes.
The terrain grid is reproduced unchanged and footing depth is approximate.
